function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Hai! Untuk membantu memeriksa ketersediaan produk berwarna pink, bisakah Anda memberi tahu nama atau kategori produk yang dimaksud? Dengan begitu, saya bisa mencari informasi lebih spesifik untuk Anda.

The user says: "Warna pink kapan restok kak". This is Indonesian: "When will the pink color restock?" They want to know when the pink color product will restock. We need to respond appropriately. We can ask clarifying question: which product? Or we can provide general info: we don't have real-time inventory. We can say we can't check real-time but we can search for product with keyword "pink" maybe. But we might need to use the function to search for products with keyword "pink" and maybe filter by category. But the user didn't specify category. We could ask them to specify product name or category. But we can also do a generic search for "pink" across all categories. But the user likely wants to know about a specific product. We should ask clarifying question: "Which product are you referring to?" So we can ask: "Could you tell me the product name or category?" That would be best.

We can also mention that we cannot guarantee restock times. So we can ask clarifying question.
